verdict_rule: CERTIFIED (the formal claim, as the textbooks define it): K0, K1, K3, KR and CR pass, C1 and C2 are refused, F2 proves BOTH blind statements' five propositions with Comparator accepting our challenge, F3 holds, R1 is proved false, and every MATERIAL item of F5 is decided. Otherwise the verdict names the first failing row: REFUTED (a proved defect in meaning: the Lean is weaker than, vacuous for, or different from the English claim), REFUSED (a row could not be run within US$25 of pods or the time it needs), or OPEN (undecided, with the reason). What CERTIFIED would not say: that any human has checked the mathematics; anything beyond the trusted base (the kernels, the three axioms, the Mathlib definitions our statements use).
